title: fix(runtime): a hook refused for a missing capability answers a coded 403 naming the hook and the capability, not a bare 500
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9c376YYAn4DZo8EvEWKB1w)_

Fixes #26903

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：hook 的沙箱 body 调用了没授予的能力（如没声明 `api.read` 却调 `ctx.api.find`）时，保存记录不再回 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`，而是回 `403 INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES`（标准目录已有的码，未新增任何码），消息点名是哪个 hook、缺哪个能力、怎么补。
- 为什么改：用户和作者原来只看到「Internal server error」，不知道是哪个 hook、缺什么；这是 Studio 里写 hook 最常见的坑（#26726 的服务端一半）。
- 风险与回滚：能力检查本身一点没放松，有能力的 hook 行为不变；只改 hook 来源的拒绝怎么作答，action/job body 缺能力仍是 500。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` 的 `throwCapabilityDenial`；`hook-capability-denial-is-a-refusal.integration.test.ts`；`hook-capability-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/sandbox/hook-capability-denial-is-a-refusal.integration.test.ts`，预期 15 项全过（5 个能力 × abort / log / 有能力对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/runtime`**, `quickjs-runner.ts`: every capability gate (`ctx.api.object(x).METHOD` for `api.read` / `api.write`, `ctx.api.transaction`, `ctx.log.*`, `ctx.crypto.randomUUID`, `ctx.title(field)`) now throws through one helper, `throwCapabilityDenial`. In a **hook** body the denial crosses the VM as a coded refusal: a plain error carrying `code: 'INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES'` and `status: 403`, exactly the shape a body's own `throw Object.assign(new Error(…), { code, status })` has. The pump loop then builds the same `SandboxError` (with `innerMessage`, `code`, `status`) it builds for that throw, and `mapDataError`'s sandbox unwrap arm answers it. The sentence keeps the gate's existing text and adds the remedy: `capability 'api.read' not granted to hook 'H' (called ctx.api.object('OBJ').find). Grant it by adding 'api.read' to the hook's body.capabilities.`
- In an **action** or **job** body the helper calls `throwSandboxFault` as before, so those keep the #4431 fault contract (`500`). The seat ruling covered hook bodies only.
- `scripts/error-status-unpinned-baseline.json`: `INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES` leaves the unpinned list, because a producer now declares its status (`check:error-status-conformance --update`, a ratchet-down).
- Docblocks on `SandboxError.innerMessage`, the pump loop's fault branch and `capability-denial-is-a-fault.test.ts` say a hook denial is the exception.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

## Why

A hook whose body calls `ctx.api` without the capability is a common authoring mistake (QA run G11). The gate refused it correctly, but the runner marked the denial as its own fault, so a save answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with `Internal server error`. Neither the caller nor the author learned which hook or which capability. Per the seat ruling, a capability refusal in a hook body is a refusal, and it is answered with a code the spec already declares.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-capability-denial-is-a-refusal.integration.test.ts` (new, 15): real `ObjectQL`, real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), real `QuickJSScriptRunner` and hook wrapper, read off `mapDataError`. For each of the five tokens:
  - `onError: abort`: `403`, `code: INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES`, the sentence names the hook, the capability and the remedy, carries neither `threw:` nor `SandboxError`, no row is written, and the BodyRunner logs one `info` refusal line with no `error` line.
  - `onError: log`: the save proceeds and the `[hook] handler failed (onError=log; suppressing)` line names the hook, object, event and the capability.
  - Control: the same body with the capability runs, and nothing is logged as refused or failed.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/hook-capability-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 4): the real stack through `POST /data/OBJECT` (abort → `403 INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES` naming hook and `api.read`, nothing written; `log` → saved; control → saved and the body's read ran).

## Acceptance notes

- **The `onError: log` half of the card did not reproduce on current main.** At `e1ab32ed` the denial is already logged under `log`, twice at `ERROR` (live `os dev` log below; the composition `log` cases pass on main too). What the QA run likely read as "nothing is logged" is the body's own `ctx.log.info(…)` line, which the gate correctly refuses without `log`. This PR keeps the hook-error line (now with the remedy) and pins it. Under `log` the BodyRunner line moves from `ERROR` with a stack to the `info` refusal line, like every other hook refusal.
- **Code choice.** `INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES` ("Operation requires higher privileges") is a `StandardErrorCode` member. It is not `PERMISSION_DENIED`, which reads as the *caller* lacking a permission and whose `[Security] Access denied` prefix matcher would flatten it. No ledger row and no spec change. #26831 is still open and unmerged, so no code from it was used.
- **Console.** The console's `isPermissionError` treats every 403 as its fixed "no permission" line, so the Studio/record toast does not show this sentence until a UI card reads `code`. That belongs with #26726 (the UI half). No UI change here.
- **Action and job bodies** still answer `500` for a capability denial (`capability-denial-is-a-fault.test.ts`, unchanged). Aligning them is a separate decision, raised in the report.
- **Overlap with #26831** (open, touches `quickjs-runner.ts` and `body-runner.ts`): `git merge-tree` with its head `e5597836` auto-merges `quickjs-runner.ts`. Semantically its host-relay marker is set in `hostErrorToVm`, which this denial goes through, so a hook with a `refusals` catalogue passes the 403 through unchanged.
- `packages/types` keeps its comment that cites a hook capability text as an example of a sandbox own fault (`data-error-classification.ts`). It is still true for action and job bodies and is not touched here (outside the claim's file surface).

## Verification

**At head `60488efa`**, branched from `origin/main` `e1ab32ed`. Every build and test ran under `os-verify-lock`.

- **Dispatch gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 71 families on this diff. All 71 were run with each exit code captured before any pipe, and all 71 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
  - Round 1 (at `2f1dacec`) had two reds, both fixed: `check:driver-memory-census` (the composition test first used `InMemoryDriver`; it now uses `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3, no ledger row added) and `check:error-status-conformance` (`INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES` is now status-pinned by a producer; the baseline was ratcheted down with `--update`).
- Full `pnpm build` before the gates: exit 0 (116 of 116 tasks).

- **Live red/green through `POST /api/v1/data`** (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, showcase, a writable package `app.probe1`, object `probe1_note`, hook `probe1_guard` on `beforeInsert`, body reads `ctx.api.object('probe1_note').find({})`):

```

{"error":"Internal server error","code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"} 500
records: ['before hooks']
log, no capability:
ERROR [BodyRunner] sandboxed hook threw {"appId":"runtime-authored","hook":"probe1_guard","error":{"message":"capability 'log' not granted to hook 'probe1_guard'", "stack": "SandboxError: …"}}
ERROR [hook] handler failed (onError=log; suppressing) {"hook":"probe1_guard","object":"probe1_note","event":"beforeInsert","error":"capability 'log' not granted to hook 'probe1_guard'"}
```
</details>

<details><summary>this branch</summary>

```
abort, no capability:
{"error":"capability 'api.read' not granted to hook 'probe1_guard' (called ctx.api.object('probe1_note').find). Grant it by adding 'api.read' to the hook's body.capabilities.","code":"INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES","object":"probe1_note"} 403
records: ['before hooks']
control, with api.read: 201, records: ['before hooks', 'control probe (1)']
log, no capability: 201
ERROR [hook] handler failed (onError=log; suppressing) {"hook":"probe1_guard","object":"probe1_note","event":"beforeInsert","error":"hook 'probe1_guard' threw: SandboxError: capability 'log' not granted to hook 'probe1_guard'. Grant it by adding 'log' to the hook's body.capabilities."}
records: ['before hooks', 'control probe (1)', 'log probe']
```
</details>

- **Red first, each pin.** With `quickjs-runner.ts` set to its `e1ab32ed` blob (committed fix first, restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and checked by blob hash and a clean `git status`):
  - composition file: 5 failed, 10 passed of 15. The five failures are exactly the five `onError: abort` cases (`expected 500 to be 403`). The `log` and control cases pass on main, which is the measured reading above.
  - dogfood file (runtime rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` confirmed the marker gone from `dist/`): 1 failed, 3 passed of 4, `{"error":"Internal server error","code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}: expected 500 to be 403`. Restored, rebuilt, preflight confirmed the marker back in `dist/`, 4 of 4 pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/sandbox src/domains`: 188 files, 4590 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on `packages/runtime` and the new dogfood file: exit 0.
- Dogfood: not owed as a full run (no `!`, no narrowing arm); the one new dogfood file was run as above.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
